sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN ps.skill = 'RAG' THEN 'Mentions RAG' ELSE 'Does not mention RAG' END AS rag_mention,
  AVG(mcf.p50) AS median_pay_midpoint
FROM mart_comp_by_family AS mcf
LEFT JOIN fct_posting AS fp ON mcf.family = fp.family AND mcf.seniority = fp.seniority
LEFT JOIN posting_skills AS ps ON fp.posting_key = ps.posting_key AND ps.skill = 'RAG'
WHERE
  fp.is_open AND fp.remote_us AND fp.is_canonical_listing
GROUP BY
  rag_mention;
